description:
Replace the values in benchbox/core/cost/pricing_data.yaml, which have never been changed since initial release and are wrong on five of nine priced platforms.

Redshift: replace the whole table from the AWS Price List API (errors -18%..+40%); delete retired ds2.xlarge/ds2.8xlarge; add ra3.large and the rg.large/xlarge/4xlarge/12xlarge family, whose absence causes a silent $1.00/node-hour fallback (rg.12xlarge real $9.128 = 89% underbill).

BigQuery: $5.00 -> $6.25/TiB for the US/EU/asia multi-regions (confirmed on the vendor pricing page). Apply the announced uniform 25% uplift to remaining pinned regions, marked as derived rather than cited. Extend the region matcher to africa-south1, northamerica-south1, asia-southeast3/4, europe-north2, europe-west10/12.

Firebolt: firebolt_fbu_price 0.0833 -> vendor range $0.23 (Standard US) to $0.42 (Enterprise non-US); pick and document the tier modelled.

Synapse dedicated: non-uniform correction - us 1.20->1.51, eu 1.44->1.51, ap 1.56->1.81, other 1.68->2.42 per 100 DWU-hour; add the missing ca tier (1.33, which is cheaper than us).

Azure Databricks: replace the synthesized aws x 1.1 block with Azure Retail Prices API values; delete the fictitious azure.enterprise tier; premium.all_purpose 0.60->0.55; premium.jobs 0.22->0.30 (0.22 is the retired Jobs Light SKU).

Databricks SQL: add the warehouse-type keys production actually emits - sql_classic 0.22, sql_pro 0.55, sql_serverless 0.70 - and wire integration.py's serverless_sql/sql_compute onto them. This is the data half of the Critical C1 defect.

Fabric: eu 0.20->0.22; other 0.20->0.28 so an unknown region is never cheaper than a known one.

Snowflake: add the missing vps edition ($6.00/credit), which currently resolves silently to $2.00.

Lands first, before any mechanism change: adding keys and correcting values can only reduce the number of runs that fall back, so no cost coverage regresses.
